content:
maria-g: quick heads up — planning to ramp runtime-gated feature flags for quota routing tomorrow morning. Need a short runbook and telemetry sampling plan. Anyone available? :wave:

sam-b: timeline? which flags exactly? route_weight_gate and quota_override_v2?

maria-g: yes. route_weight_gate and quota_override_v2. Start at 0700 PT, 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~3 hours if telemetry looks good.

tj: suggestion: evaluation order should be "explicit route" -> "customer cohort" -> "global default". Fail-open during canary. Also include safe fallback to previous config variant.

tj: sample config snippet:
```
{
 "flag": "route_weight_gate",
 "gating": {
  "predicate_order": ["route", "cohort", "default"],
  "fail_mode": "open"
 },
 "rollout": {"steps":[1,10,50,100],"hold_mins":30}
}
```

lee: telemetry note — stratified sampling by route + status. We should 100% sample any request with error, 25% sample 5xx latency outliers, 5% sample successes, and 0.1% sample debug-only paths. That preserves signal for regressions without overwhelming logs.

lee: also wire up the rollout dashboard: show per-route token consumption, p95 latency, error rate, and "safety signals" (quota breaches, fallback hits).

nirav: oncall/runbook: what are the exact pause and rollback commands? We need a single API call for the console to hit during incidents.

maria-g: use the admin API: `POST /internal/admin/flags/{flag}/pause` with body `\{"reason\":"canary-signal","until":"-"\}`

maria-g: rollback is `POST /internal/admin/flags/{flag}/rollout` body `\{"to": "previous"\}` — both require ops token.

nirav: can we add a "deadman" auto-pause if error rate > 0.5% absolute increase for 5m? :thinking: 

tj: yes. config-bot will support "auto_pause" predicate. set default threshold to 0.5% and configurable per-flag.

config-bot: Automated: created RFC for auto_pause predicates at https://go/internal/rfc/flags-auto-pause (stub). :robot_face:

lee: minor UX ask — console should show current sampling rates next to the flag and a link "runbook" to open the short incident playbook.

sam-b: +1. Also need telemetry tags emitted: flag.name, rollout.step, sample_bucket, predicate_hit. Without those, analysis is painful.

maria-g: ok I'll update the runbook and the flag schema PR. tagging @oncall for visibility — @ops-oncall please stand by 0700 PT tomorrow.

ops-oncall: noted. we'll monitor dashboards and will escalate if safety signals fire. :thumbsup:

maria-g: thanks all. I'll push the PR to add sampling and auto_pause by EOD and post a short checklist here. :sparkles:
